seedMetadata.description: Independent, fully synthetic English retrieval relevance fixture, authored before any retrieval or ranking runs. Not part of the agent usage-propensity harness and not derived from live memories or private user data. Eligibility: omitted status means active only; an explicit status array is inclusive. Global scope returns only global memories. Project scope returns only project-scoped memories; omitted match means any project intersection, while all requires the memory to include every requested project. Relevance is binary usefulness to the stated information need, not mere topical overlap; relevant lists enumerate all eligible useful memories, with no top-k truncation or ordering significance. Spelling mistakes retain their apparent intended meaning. Development and heldout queries share the fixed corpus; heldout is diagnostic, not a fresh validated ship-quality holdout. Small hand-authored cases intentionally cover both lexical and semantic needs without claiming a representative production distribution. Verification values are synthetic metadata, not evidence of real observations. Freeze this corpus and these judgments before evaluating alternatives; do not revise labels in response to ranking outcomes.

evaluationCorpus: full supplied corpus; no subsampling or split-specific indexing
